questions.question: A mechanical hard drive emits a loud rhythmic clicking sound when reading data and experiences S.M.A.R.T. errors. What action should be taken immediately? [Scenario 25]
options: B) Backup critical data and replace the drive
questions.explanation: The 'click of death' indicates head actuator mechanical failure; immediate backup is required before complete failure.

questions.question: A PC receives an IP address of 169.254.112.45 and cannot access the internet. What issue occurred? [Scenario 25]
options: B) Failed DHCP negotiation resulting in an APIPA address
questions.explanation: IP addresses in the 169.254.x.x range are APIPA addresses auto-assigned when DHCP servers fail to respond.

questions.question: A desktop PC turns on with fans spinning but displays no video and fails POST. Which initial troubleshooting steps should be taken? (Select TWO) [Scenario 25]
options: A) Reseat CPU, RAM, and PCIe expansion cards
B) Inspect motherboard status diagnostic LEDs
questions.explanation: No POST failures point to core component seated improperly or hardware initialization failure, diagnosed via status LEDs.

questions.question: An LCD monitor displays flickering horizontal lines whenever the display stand is tilted. What is the most likely cause? [Scenario 25]
options: A) Loose or damaged video display cable
questions.explanation: Physical movement causing display flickering indicates a loose connection or damaged wiring in the video cable.
